declaration.objective: Separate a faster completed-4h turning hypothesis from a fresh trend-pullback continuation hypothesis. Prospective only; no profitability or early-entry guarantee.
declaration.baseline: Current main hourly Donchian20 plus completed-4h strict alignment technical rules, with the SAME additional public scheduled macro entry guard used by BOTH candidates. This baseline can differ from the actual main account during macro blackouts.
declaration.turning: Keep original Donchian20 raw signal and its extension/EMA60/activity/quality checks. Admit original strict 4h context OR completed-4h fast on the directional side of BOTH mid and slow, close on slow side, unchanged abs(fast-slow)/close>=0.004, and mid[-1]-mid[-4] in trade direction. Never use forming 4h candles.
declaration.turn_pullback: Use turning context. Original Donchian raw has priority; only if absent may the existing fixed hourly trend_pullback mechanism emit a fresh reclaim. Preserve its full EMA8/24/60 ordering, rising/falling mid over six bars, previous close across EMA8, fast/mid minimum separation and <=1ATR extension. A rejected Donchian cannot fall back to bypass a gate.
declaration.pullback_admission: Freeze actual original hourly EMA8 and two-bar structure plus 0.25ATR buffer. Existing initial 2ATR/minimum/maximum stop must contain that structure at signal, quote and actual fill. Mark, executable quote and fill must stay strictly on the frozen reclaimed side; preserve 0.5ATR chase and 1ATR extension. Do not revive an expired prior breakout.
declaration.retained_risk: Per-symbol original stops, targets, trailing exits, holding cap, funding, drawdown, liquidity, <=1x gross notional, leverage ceiling, 0.25% equity risk, 3-bar cooldown, one-hour validity, no automatic reversal, company earnings guard. Shared macro guard pre30/post90 from causally available source events affects only new risk.
declaration.costs: Normal/double independently size and execute. Double both taker fee and adverse slippage; common observed funding settlement. Same market batch, company calendar and public context per tick. Different entry histories are independent-account outcomes, not matched-trade causal profits.
declaration.epoch: 18 NEW independent 1000-USDT ledgers, total hypothetical18000 research capital, never combined with main4000 or prior experiments. Verified exchange inception after declaration; warmup builds indicators only. Only strictly post-inception boundaries, actual current books, no backfill fills. Preserve old60 accounts and all epochs.
declaration.evidence: MU/SKH timing cases and prior mechanism research have already been inspected. Rule choices are generic fixed hypotheses, not a parameter sweep or validation on those known cases. Any replay is diagnostic, not unseen forward performance.
declaration.review: At least14days AND10 fully closed positions per relevant symbol/arm, fresh reconciled data, normal AND double costs, estimated open-position close costs, drawdown, churn, lost winners and best-winner dependence. Also inspect turning vs baseline and incremental pullback vs turning. Readiness is not a pass; no automatic promotion.
declaration.first_seen: Persist actual signal observation time, lag from complete hour boundary, variant and immutable context hashes. Early describes admission stage; closing-hour rules still have finite latency.
